In Karnataka, policymakers held a data centre roundtable at Bengaluru Tech Summit 2026, and the office should monitor regional tech strategies.
In Chennai, DMK headquarters condemned TVK's new health policy regarding medical and liquor corporation policies, and the office should monitor political reactions.
